tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. Paper in light, a deeper ink in dark.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, inputs and the exam sheet.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dividers that separate, never the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders. 3:1 or more on bg and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body copy and headings on bg and surface (11:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, metadata on bg and surface (5.3:1 light, 8.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The reading and the one primary action per view. A fill, never text on bg.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (5.8:1). Never white.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind text that marks the learner's current reading.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links on bg and surface. Underlined, so colour is never the only cue.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: solid 2px, 2px offset. 5.7:1 or more on every ground.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and failed submissions, always with a word and an icon. Text on bg and surface (5.1:1 or more).

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind danger text in error banners.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Brand Ink. The bubble of the mark, dark bands, the gauge disc. Fixed in both themes.

tokens.name: depth
tokens.usage: Brand Depth. The mark's shadow layer, secondary brand fills.

tokens.name: sea
tokens.usage: Brand Sea. Gauge pages for levels already reached. Decoration only, never text.

tokens.name: lagoon
tokens.usage: Brand Lagoon. Gauge pages, illustration fills. Never text on light grounds.

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Brand Mist. The page just before the reading; text only on Ink.

tokens.name: unreached
tokens.usage: Brand Unreached. Gauge pages for levels not reached yet, always on Ink.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Brand Amber. The reading. On Ink or as a fill with Ink text; never as text on Paper.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Brand Paper. The book in the mark, light grounds, Ink-on-Paper print.

styles.name: headline-xl
styles.usage: Hero headlines on the site and campaign posters. One per page.

styles.name: headline-l
styles.usage: Section openers, social post headlines. Mobile hero size.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: We estimate your level from the exam's own rules, then tell you how sure we are.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Answer the questions in the order they appear.
styles.usage: Default text. Never smaller for running copy on mobile.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows and tags, set in capitals.

styles.name: score
styles.usage: The reading in the exam's own scale. Tabular figures.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: Reference only: the wordmark is artwork. Use the lockup files, never live text.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight groups: chips, inline controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Form field gaps, list rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile, minimum side gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on tablet and desktop, gaps between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections inside a screen.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between page sections on mobile.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Between page sections on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, tags, small inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, menus.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, modals.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Level badges, avatars, the gauge disc.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Raised cards and sheets. Flat cards use line instead.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything tappable.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum content width on desktop.

tokens.name: read-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of running text and exam passages.
